name: NVIDIA
description: Accelerator vendor whose rack-scale platforms set the power and cooling envelope for AI halls. GB300 NVL72 is a fully liquid-cooled rack integrating 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs and 36 Arm-based Grace CPUs; GB200 NVL72 is the earlier liquid-cooled rack-scale design.
notes: Neither product page states a kW-per-rack figure; the liquid-cooling claim is a design property, not a stated requirement. A rack-power number for the card must come from a DGX SuperPOD reference architecture, not these pages.

sources.note: 72 Blackwell Ultra GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs, fully liquid-cooled rack-scale, read 2026-11-16
